ref: ADR-0008 (an attribute is a leaf field); ADR-0006 since #102 (a target attribute is a leaf, 1..1 when use="required", whose item comes first in its element's content)
note: The required attribute code of the root Coded per Id in its default context Order: the root's slot 1 reads context 1, X1. V per Id in context Orders: X1, X2. The attribute is written on Coded before its children. The target attribute was unsupported-field until #102.
